title: Wall, turntable and projector · plan

techniques.name: Rig plan

tturn.label: Turntable
tturn.note: Angle of the lazy susan carrying the blocks, held still (the page spins it).

lampz.label: Throw
lampz.note: Distance from the projector to the wall: nearer throws bigger, softer-edged shadows.

lampx.label: Projector offset
lampx.note: The projector’s place left or right of the wall’s center line; past 1.5 the mask side loses its terrain.

tablez.label: Table distance
tablez.note: How far the turntable stands from the wall: nearer the wall, smaller and sharper shadows; nearer the projector, larger and softer.

techniques.implementation: A wall, a turntable and a projector drawn in plan and in elevation. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
notes: Sources: Claude artifact · The Cave Rig
